test_title: PYST 49: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 07 Mar, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

____ and neglect resulted in a government that was weakened enough to be overthrown.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Corruption**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The noun "**Corruption**" is the appropriate word to use in this context.
 
• The sentence describes a situation where corrupt practices and neglect led to the weakening of the government.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"Corruption and neglect resulted in a government that was weakened enough to be overthrown."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "Corrupt"** is incorrect because it is an adjective, not a noun.
 
• **Option 3: "Corrupted"** is incorrect because it is a past participle, not a noun.
 
• **Option 4: "Corrupting"** is incorrect because it is a present participle, not a noun.
